segments.t: In his office at ASK, Mathias receives a phone call from Hicham. Hicham announces that Solaris has signed the rival co-production deal. Mathias feigns total devastation while Noemie listens in secrecy. Listen to the scene in French first.
Allô, Hicham? Comment vas-tu?
Ils ont signé hier soir le contrat.
Ce n'est pas vrai, c'est signé?
Oui, le deal de coproduction est fait.
Je ne savais pas du tout cela.
Franchement, je suis totalement consterné.
C'est vraiment une terrible malchance.
Nous avons perdu ce projet ensemble.
Je ne vois rien d'autre à faire.
Je suis vraiment navré, Hicham.
Merci, on se voit demain au bureau.
Oui, à demain. Salut, Hicham.
Il a tout cru sans hésiter?
Absolument, notre secret est bien gardé.
Let's walk through the conversation step by step.
Allô, Hicham? Comment vas-tu?
'Hello, Hicham? How are you doing?' Mathias answers the phone with polite calm. The casual greeting masks his secret agenda.
Ils ont signé hier soir le contrat.
'They signed the contract yesterday evening.' Hicham delivers the bad news about the rival deal. The past tense reports the signing.
Ce n'est pas vrai, c'est signé?
'It is not true, it is signed?' Mathias feigns complete disbelief. The question displays manufactured shock.
Oui, le deal de coproduction est fait.
'Yes, the co-production deal is done.' Hicham confirms the deal with Solaris. The short confirmation expresses defeat.
Je ne savais pas du tout cela.
'I did not know that at all.' Mathias denies any prior knowledge. The emphatic negative phrase reinforces his innocent facade.
Franchement, je suis totalement consterné.
'Frankly, I am totally dismayed.' He exaggerates his emotional distress. The adverb emphasizes his fake grief.
C'est vraiment une terrible malchance.
'It is really terrible bad luck.' Mathias laments the supposed stroke of misfortune. The strong adjective intensifies the regret.
Nous avons perdu ce projet ensemble.
'We lost this project together.' Hicham mourns their mutual loss. The plural pronoun stresses agency solidarity.
Je ne vois rien d'autre à faire.
'I see nothing else to do.' Mathias claims total helplessness. The negative structure closes off further action.
Je suis vraiment navré, Hicham.
'I am truly sorry, Hicham.' He offers condolences to his rival boss. The courteous adjective sounds completely genuine.
Merci, on se voit demain au bureau.
'Thank you, see you tomorrow at the office.' Hicham thanks him and ends the call. The farewell sets up tomorrow's meeting.
Oui, à demain. Salut, Hicham.
'Yes, see you tomorrow. Bye, Hicham.' Mathias says goodbye and hangs up. The quick farewell concludes the fake call.
Il a tout cru sans hésiter?
'He believed everything without hesitating?' Noemie asks if the boss fell for the trick. The prepositional phrase highlights the deceit.
Absolument, notre secret est bien gardé.

'Absolutely, our secret is well kept.' Mathias smiles with triumph. The passive construction reassures his accomplice. Now listen to the whole scene again at normal speed, and see how much more you catch.

Mathias's cunning act keeps Hicham completely in the dark about his secret maneuvers. Listen to the conversation once more in French.
Notre plan fonctionne à la perfection.
